title: How Oracle Aggregation & Staleness Detection Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Consumer["Protocol Logic"]
        A[Collateral / liquidation logic] --> B[Request asset price]
    end
    subgraph Validate["Oracle Read & Validation"]
        B --> C["Call latestRoundData()"]
        C --> D{"updatedAt fresh?"}
        D -->|No| R[Revert: stale data]
        D -->|Yes| E{"Within minAnswer / maxAnswer?"}
        E -->|No| R
        E -->|Yes| F{"L2 sequencer up?"}
        F -->|No| R
        F -->|Yes| G[Return validated price]
    end
    G --> H[Value collateral & set borrow limits]

title: Attack Vector: Stale & Manipulated Prices
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Stale["Staleness Failures"]
        S1["Destructure answer only"] --> S2[Old price looks current]
        S3[LUNA crashes below floor] --> S4["Feed pinned at minAnswer $0.10"]
        S5[L2 sequencer offline] --> S6[Frozen price reads as live]
    end
    subgraph Manip["Same-Tx Manipulation"]
        M1[Flash loan] --> M2[Skew DEX reserves]
        M2 --> M3["Read spot price slot0 / get_dy"]
    end
    S2 --> X[Protocol books wrong price]
    S4 --> X
    S6 --> X
    M3 --> X
    X --> Y[Borrow / mint / liquidate]
    Y --> Z[Attacker drains the difference]

title: Defense: Layered Freshness & Bounds Checks
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Read latestRoundData] --> B{"updatedAt + staleAfter >= now?"}
    B -->|No| F[Revert]
    B -->|Yes| C{"answeredInRound >= roundId?"}
    C -->|No| F
    C -->|Yes| D["Apply per-feed maxStaleness"]
    D --> E{"minAnswer < answer < maxAnswer?"}
    E -->|No| F
    subgraph L2["L2 Sequencer Guards"]
        G{"sequencer answer == 1?"} -->|Down| F
        G -->|Up| H{"now - startedAt > grace period?"}
        H -->|No| F
    end
    E -->|Yes| G
    H -->|Yes| I[Corroborate via TWAP / 2nd source]
    I --> J[Use trusted price]
